countDefinitions.collections: Current generated real GFL2 event groups assembled by src/content.ts, excluding opening preview and fictional fixtures.
countDefinitions.stories: Each event.sections entry is one individually readable section; includes optional side-story branches. Does not count combat-only nodes or pending chapters.
countDefinitions.readableStoryCount: Prepared chapter and every declared local chapter/source/scene asset file exists on disk. Does not claim complete reconstruction of every source effect or public download availability.
countDefinitions.passages: Entries in every current reader JSON passages array, including non-dialogue reading steps.
countDefinitions.voiceLanguages: Union of imported cutscene voices, never evidence of voiced regular dialogue.
countDefinitions.movieCount: Distinct source movie IDs across scene videos. Repeated use across chapters counted once; male/female picture variants are separate source URLs.
countDefinitions.musicAndSound: Distinct recovered cue labels referenced by Bgm/Se commands with resolved assets, not a count of unique audio compositions or bytes.
